webdav.stempel.hinweis: PDFs come out of the drive stamped with this template; the original in Ablago stays unchanged. If a folder type requires a stamp, its stamp always applies – even with “No stamp”.
webdav.nur-lesend.hinweis: for all users: browsing and opening yes, filing, changing and deleting no
eingangsordner.es-ist-kein-eingangsordne: No intake folder is mounted. Mount a folder of your NAS as {code} into the container – see the manual.
eingangsordner.geprueft-nichts-fertiges-: Checked – nothing finished found. A file is only taken over once it no longer changes between two checks.
eingangsordner.jede-fertige-datei-im: Every finished file in the folder {code} becomes a new post (channel “Folder”). A subfolder named after a user’s full e-mail address, e.g. {code2}, enters that user under “To”.
eingangsordner.eine-andere-instanz-von: Another Ablago instance takes over the intake folder; this one waits.
eingangsordner.liegt-genau-diese-datei: – if exactly this file is already in Ablago, no post is created; the file is tidied away as above
eingangsordner.werden-uebernommen-sobald: (taken over as soon as they no longer change)
eingangsordner.abgelehnte-dateien-liegen: Rejected files are in {code}, next to them a text file with the reason.
eingangsordner.ordner-automatisch: Create folders for new users automatically
eingangsordner.ordner-automatisch.text: – one folder named after the e-mail address of each new person; if the address changes, Ablago renames it too
eingangsordner.warnen.text: All files under /eingang count, including erledigt/ and fehler/. 0 turns a warning off.
eingangsordner.personen.ohne_one: {anzahl} active user has no folder of their own yet.
eingangsordner.personen.ohne_other: {anzahl} active users have no folder of their own yet.
eingangsordner.ohne-person: Folder “{ordner}” does not belong to any user.
eingangsordner.ohne-person.text: Post from it arrives without “To”. Only a folder named after a user’s full e-mail address sets “To” – rename it or create the folders per person.
eingangsordner.umbenennen: Folder “{alt}” could not be renamed to “{neu}”.
eingangsordner.umbenennen.text: The person’s e-mail address has changed. Rename the folder on the NAS by hand, otherwise post from it arrives without “To”.
eingangsordner.ueberwachung.noch-nicht: Not calculated yet – comes with the next check.
eingangsordner.ueberwachung.text: All files under /eingang per folder, including erledigt/ and fehler/. Calculated {zeit}; Ablago recalculates at most every five minutes, “Check now” at once.
eingangsordner.ueberwachung.gekuerzt: Very many folders: not all are listed, but the figures still count them.
eingangsordner.ueberwachung.zu-tief_one: {anzahl} file lies deeper than 5 levels and is not taken over.
eingangsordner.ueberwachung.zu-tief_othe: {anzahl} files lie deeper than 5 levels and are not taken over.
eingangsordner.warnung.alt: Files have been in the intake folder for more than {tage} days.
eingangsordner.warnung.fehler_one: {zahl} file in fehler/ could not be processed.
eingangsordner.warnung.fehler_other: {zahl} files in fehler/ could not be processed.
eingangsordner.warnung.anzahl: There are {zahl} files in the intake folder.
texterkennung.alle-koennen-sich-wieder: Everyone can sign in again; background work carries on.
texterkennung.neue-dokumente-bleiben-in: {b}{warten} New documents stay in the queue until you switch it on.{wert}
texterkennung.pausiert-solange-der-wartu: Paused while maintenance mode is on.
texterkennung.zeitgrenze.text: If a job runs longer than the base value plus the time per page, Ablago cancels it: the document then shows "failed – time limit" (with "Try again"), and the next job starts. If a package reads the texts, the limits of the package runner also apply.
texterkennung.zeitgrenze.uebersicht_one: One text recognition job was cancelled in the last 24 hours because of the time limit.
texterkennung.zeitgrenze.uebersicht_othe: {anzahl} text recognition jobs were cancelled in the last 24 hours because of the time limit.
texterkennung.zeitgrenze.uebersicht.text: Are they stuck in a package or are the documents very large? Check the errors under Text recognition, raise the time limit if needed and try them again.
texterkennung.noch-keine-die-sprache: None yet – the language shows on every document once it has a full text.
texterkennung.arbeiten-am-ganzen-bestand: Work on the whole collection that you start when needed. It runs in the background; Ablago stays usable.
texterkennung.dokumente-stehen-wieder-in: {zahl} document is back in the queue.
{zahl} documents are back in the queue.
texterkennung.fuer-dateien-entstehen-jet: A thumbnail is now being created in the background for {zahl} file.
Thumbnails are now being created in the background for {zahl} files.
texterkennung.nichts-nachzuholen-alle-pd: Nothing to catch up – all PDFs and images already have a thumbnail.
texterkennung.neben-jedem-pdf-und: Next to every PDF and image the Library shows a small picture of the first page. For new documents it’s created right after uploading, for older ones the first time they’re shown. This creates the missing ones at once – one after another in the background.
webdav.die-ablage-als-laufwerk: The Library as a drive in Explorer, Finder or the Files app: read folders, open documents (with export permission) and put files into “New post” or a tab folder. Sign-in uses the email address and an API key, never the password.
webdav.die-adresse-von-ablago: Ablago’s address doesn’t start with {code}. Windows only mounts a drive with sign-in over HTTPS, and without HTTPS the API keys would travel openly over the network. Set up HTTPS first (Workbench → Email and address, reverse proxy).
webdav.benutzer-erzeugen-den-schluessel: Users create the key themselves under My account → Security → API keys (“read and write”, so they can file). Administrators also use the drive with their everyday permissions – a key never gets administration rights.
webdav.seit-dem-letzten-start: No access since the last start yet.
webdav.nur-im-arbeitsspeicher-nach: Only in memory; after a restart the list is empty.
texterkennung.abbrechen.text: The selected documents leave the queue. You can restart them later.
